verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say it manages option exercises ("vesting, and exercises globally") and issues equity, so exercise handling is a documented capability. Nothing shows an employee-facing online flow, payment handling, or automatic share issuance after exercise. missing for 10: employee self-service online exercise flow, in-platform exercise payment, automated share issuance on exercise, paperless/e-signature confirmation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms

citations.quote: Set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises globally.
Track, issue, and report equity with a single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees.
